title: AssurAI: Experience with Constructing Korean Socio-cultural Datasets to Discover Potential Risks of Generative AI
reasoning: The paper develops a dataset and benchmark (AssurAI) centered on a taxonomy of 35 risk factors. This taxonomy includes numerous categories dedicated to evaluating moral and ethical harms, such as 'Hate Speech', 'Discriminatory Activities', 'Celebrating Suffering', and 'Violent Acts', specifically tailored to the Korean socio-cultural context.
